general_information.Description: -Course Objectives: Master the art of persuasion through understanding ethos, pathos, and logos. Develop strong argumentation and critical thinking skills. Analyze and adapt to diverse audiences. Improve public speaking delivery, including vocal variety, body language, and eye contact. Utilize research to support persuasive claims. Construct persuasive speeches using various organizational patterns. Provide and receive constructive feedback on persuasive presentations. -Course Description: This course is designed to equip students with the essential skills to craft and deliver compelling persuasive speeches. Through a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical application, students will learn to analyze audiences, develop strong arguments, and effectively communicate their ideas. The course emphasizes critical thinking, research, and public speaking skills. Students will have the opportunity to practice their persuasive abilities through in-class presentations and receive constructive feedback from peers and the instructor. By the end of the course, students will be confident in their ability to persuade and influence others and equiped students with the soft skills necessary to thrive in today's competitive job market. -Teaching method: interactive and contructivist approach and/or Project Based Learning
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Access the course website (https://fu-edunext.fpt.edu.vn/) for group discussions to contruct knowledge, for practicing and assessment
general_information.Note: 1) On-going assessment - Assignments: 03*20%: 60% 2) Final Examination (FE) 40% 3) Final Result 100% 4) Completion Criteria: On-going assessment >0, Final Exam Score >=4/10 & Final Result >=5/10

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Plan and deliver speeches with a clear introduction, body, and conclusion
Research and develop engaging content that is relevant to the audience.
Use effective vocal delivery (tone, pace, volume) and body language to enhance their message.
Adjust their speaking style to suit different audiences, contexts and situations.
Respond effectively to questions and challenges.
Use visual aids (e.g., slides, props) to enhance their presentation.
Evaluate their own performance and incorporate feedback to improve.
Work effectively in a team environment and contribute to shared goals
Take responsibility for their actions and their impact on others.
Adapt to change and embrace new challenges.

Create a realistic scenario where a person struggles with this habit and experiences its negative effects. Focus on a positive outcome where the person successfully breaks the habit using your proposed plan.
